newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland to host Eurovision Song Contest on May 3.
newsitem.headline: Ireland to host Eurovision Song Contest on May 3.

text.p: Ireland is to host the 1997 Eurovision Song Contest in Dublin on May 3, the country's national broadcasting network RTE said on Thursday.
It will be the fourth time in five years that Ireland has hosted the annual competition, which chooses the best song among entries from countries across Europe.
The nation which provides the winning song earns the honour of hosting the following year's contest, and Ireland's success has been unmatched in recent years.
It was the runaway winner in 1996, although the victory was not universally welcomed in Ireland -- some newspapers grumbled about the cost of staging the competition so often.

The contest is one of the biggest television events of the year, attracting millions of viewers across Europe. The 1997 competition will cost RTE about 3 million punts ($4.8 million), Irish newspapers said. ($1=.6244 Punt)
